subject: Refocus: Intro demo → Two-part technical playbook (scheduling matrix inside)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Simmons <claire@finova.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-09T10:32:00-07:00
Subject: Refocus: Intro demo → Two-part technical playbook (scheduling matrix inside)

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for taking the time to speak with us last week. Based on your feedback and the internal goals you shared, we recommend converting the standard 30–45 minute intro call into a two-part technical playbook: a focused 90-minute hands‑on kickoff for engineering (day 1) and a 60-minute architecture & integration session (day 2). The goal is to leave your team with a scoped POC plan and clear success criteria.

I realize that’s a shift from what we previously discussed — apologies for the change midstream. We’re proposing it because we want the first meeting to be immediately actionable for your engineers rather than another high-level overview.

I attached an availability matrix with a few proposed windows (times in PDT/EDT) and a short outline of the playbook. Can you confirm:
- Which stakeholders must attend each session? (engineers, infra, security, procurement)
- Any hard constraints on length (45 min max for execs, full day availability, etc.)
- Preferences for timezone-friendly slots — we can condense to a single 90-minute session if that’s essential.

If this format works, Marcus will lead the hands-on portion and Evelyn will run the architecture follow-up. If not, we can keep to the original intro demo and shrink the scope.

Attachments: availability_matrix.xlsx, technical-playbook-outline.pdf

Thanks —
Sojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Claire Simmons <claire@finova.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jake Palmer <jake.palmer@finova.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Refocus: Intro demo → Two-part technical playbook (scheduling matrix inside)

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the thoughtful proposal. Our exec sponsor (Jake) only has a 45-minute window on the 15th, and several of our senior engineers will be traveling the week of the 20th. I want the session to be useful, but we also need to keep it tight for leadership.

Options from our side:
- Option A: Condense to a single 75–90 minute technical overview with a short live demo and a breakout for engineers (preferred if Marcus can focus on the POC checklist).
- Option B: Two shorter sessions — 60 minutes (leadership + product overview) and a 60-minute deep dive with engineering the following week.

If you can send concrete time slots for both options (leaning US morning / Finova east coast afternoon), we’ll confirm with Jake and the engineering leads. Also, please include procurement contact if there’s an NDA or SOW draft to route.

—Claire
Claire Simmons
VP of Product | Finova
claire@finova.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Simmons <claire@finova.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Refocus: Intro demo → Two-part technical playbook (scheduling matrix inside)

Thanks Claire — that’s helpful context.

Proposal (compromise):
- Day 1 (90 minutes): 30 min leadership + product alignment (Jake + Claire + Finova PM), 60 min hands‑on lab for engineers (Marcus leads).
- Day 2 (60 minutes, one week later): Architecture & integration run‑through, data flow, security checklist (Evelyn leads).

If leadership must limit to 45 minutes, we can compress Day 1 to 45 min leadership + 45 min mini-lab (90 min total) and surface the POC checklist as pre-read to keep things efficient.

Concrete slots (all in US Eastern /EDT, times also shown in PDT):
- Tue 2026-09-15: 10:00–11:30 EDT (7:00–8:30 PDT) — leadership + lab
- Wed 2026-09-16: 14:00–15:00 EDT (11:00–12:00 PDT) — architecture follow-up
- Fri 2026-09-18: 09:00–10:30 EDT (6:00–7:30 PDT) — alternate

I’ve attached an updated availability matrix showing additional cross-timezone options and a one‑page playbook outline. If you prefer Option A (single session), Marcus can run a focused 90-minute format on 9/15.

For procurement: please loop in procurement@finova.com or send an NDA/SOW contact; we can fast-track a standard mutual NDA if needed.

Attachments: availability_matrix.xlsx (updated), technical-playbook-outline.pdf

—Sojin
From: Claire Simmons <claire@finova.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jake Palmer <jake.palmer@finova.com>, procurement@finova.com
Date: 2026-09-11T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Refocus: Intro demo → Two-part technical playbook (scheduling matrix inside)

Soojin —

Confirmed: let’s go with the two‑part approach. Locking in Tue 2026-09-15 10:00–11:30 EDT for the kickoff (Jake will attend first 45 minutes), and Wed 2026-09-23 14:00–15:00 EDT for the architecture session. I’ve CC’d procurement — they’ll send an NDA link later today.

Please include a short agenda for the Day 1 lab and the required participant list (engineers: names or roles). Marcus / Evelyn — can you confirm you’re available for these slots?

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Claire
